svg.aria-label: One question tells you which situation you are in: if you are playing less and enjoying it less, you have moved on and nothing needs fixing. If you are playing the same amount or more while enjoying it less, the hours did not follow the enjoyment down, and that gap is worth acting on.

g.text: One question tells you which one you are
Are you playing less than you used to, or the same?
Those are the same fact, and the word for it is moving on.
Playing the same or more, enjoying it less
The hours did not follow the enjoyment down.
Something other than fun is keeping them there.
This is the one worth acting on.

svg.text: Boredom on its own is not the signal. Boredom that did not reduce the hours is.
